Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.

Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield with Necromancy attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

1580-4871-5332-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5332-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Carmen and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-3360-6006.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1011-2292-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2292-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2292-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1325-4050-7498-7541.notablePrerequisites: You have more life than at least one opponent.
1325-4050-7498-7541.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat until each opponent with a lower life total than your own has lost the game.

1496-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

413-3986-7124.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
413-3986-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

6797-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6797-7084-7316.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

104-3490-4659-6097.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5231-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5231-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-5231-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4186-6097-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6097-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Repeat.

You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2511-3769-5434-5555.description:

During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.

When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Gulping Scraptrap spell three times.
Resolve the first Gulping Scraptrap spell.
When the Gulping Scraptrap token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-1519.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Gulping Scraptrap spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

Osteomancer Adept does not have summoning sickness.

Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
